canonicalSourceUrl.description: Canonical article URL represented by the saved bundle.

html.description: Local saved-artifact path(s). Package convention: string values point at saved HTML files on disk, not inline HTML content.

css.description: Local saved-artifact paths for companion CSS files.

js.description: Local saved-artifact paths for companion JavaScript files.

manifests.description: Local saved-artifact paths for asset manifests recovered from the same session.

har.description: Local saved-artifact path for an optional HAR file.

screenshots.description: Local saved-artifact paths for optional screenshots captured during acquisition.

sourceTree.description: Local saved-artifact paths for optional source-tree evidence.

authoritativeViewport.description: Viewport that the saved bundle most accurately represents.

captureMethod.description: Acquisition tier that produced this bundle.

computedStyles.description: Local saved-artifact path for computed-styles.json from rendered capture.

screenshotsManifest.description: Local saved-artifact path for screenshots-manifest.json (golden parity baselines).

networkAssetManifest.description: Local saved-artifact path for network-asset-manifest.json of resolved CDN/webfont URLs.

figmaReference.description: Local saved-artifact path for figma-reference.json when a Figma capture was produced.
